_note: Verified 2026-08-23. PARALO LTD (16920170), 124 City Road, London EC1V, incorporated 2025-12-18. Companies House confirms both founders as the company's only persons with significant control: Jarrad Christopher Hicks, a director from incorporation, and Zaheer Abbas Merali, appointed 2026-07-23. An SH01 filed 2026-07-22 corroborates the raise on the register, a month before the announcement. Tech.eu describes an oversubscribed founder-led round with angels investing under SEIS and names no institutional lead. This company reached the briefing through the local RSS ingest, not through any scout or pre-draft report. Public facts only; no contact data.
one_liner: Paralo builds a single operating system for golf clubs, replacing the separate legacy tools a club runs its tee sheet, competitions, live scoring, member app, till, and finances on, plus a connected app for the golfers themselves.
headcount_source: Qualitative estimate, not a published figure: a company incorporated in December 2025 with two directors on the register, raising a GBP270k pre-seed. Uncertain.
